description: SDN identity public keys for the BIP-39 test phrase 'abandon x11 about' (empty passphrase). Ed25519 = SLIP-10 m/44'/0'/N'/0'/0' public key; X25519 = X25519 public key of the SLIP-10 m/44'/0'/N'/1'/0' private key (sdn_identity_secrets.cpp derive_purpose(0) and derive_purpose(1)); peerId = libp2p identity-multihash peer ID of the Ed25519 key. Test vectors only.
